Third-party sources

- bidi-js: https://github.com/lojjic/bidi-js, source modules from main, MIT license in bidi/LICENSE.txt. Implements Unicode 13 bidi data.
- regenerator-runtime: https://github.com/facebook/regenerator, unmodified runtime bundled for fontkit generator support, MIT license in regenerator/LICENSE.

Files retain upstream notices. Font sources and hashes are listed in public/fonts/editing/sources.json.
